note: Campground on the Jacks Fork at the east edge of Eminence (18227 Arrowhead Loop), in the Ozark National Scenic Riverways, with RV sites, tent sites, cabins and tipis. The RW row sits at the back of the campground's own open gravel river beach, which also sells swim day passes; the other RV rows are inland under scattered trees. --Claude
summary: Confirmed private RV park on its own RoverPass engine: $40 (30-amp full hookup) to $65 (RW river row), 2 people, same Jan/Jun 2027; 50-amp full hookups; 43 RV sites online, to 70 ft. Not a canoe-outfitter campground. Google 4.0 (301). Riverview kept (RW row ~25-35 m behind the open day-use beach); operator 'riverfront' claim is a lead only. Pin on the tent field, ~135 m from the RV rows (optional move).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: price $40 (RoverPass 'Full Hookups 30 Amps', 2 adults, 1 night, Tue 2027-01-26 and Sat 2027-06-12 alike; cart $40 + RoverPass platform/processing fee and tax) - under $50, no gateway needed. Presence: working operator site brokenarrowhead.com with phone 573-226-5250 (matches) + claimed, bookable RoverPass listing + Google Maps 'Broken Arrow Campground and Cabins' 4.0 stars (301 reviews). Good Sam: not a GS Park (stored false, left). Google 4.0 is exactly at the line, not under it.

REVIEWS: Google 4.0/301. Recent reviews read: 'Great place. Stayed a week... Very nice and accommodating' (a month ago); 'We did the day pass to swim and hangout at the beach along Jack's Fork River... Only $5.00 per person' (4 months ago); cabin reviews positive. One owner reply to a critical June cabin review opens 'Shame on you!' (4 months ago) - a combative reply, not a policy issue. Not borderline on price.

LONG-STAY: nothing weekly/monthly/seasonal is marketed on the operator site or RoverPass; every RV rate sells 1 night. Not long-stay in character; tests not triggered. On a Jan 2027 weeknight 28 RV sites were open online (21 at the 30-amp rate, 5 at 50-amp, 2 RW).
OUTFITTER CHECK: not a canoe-outfitter campground - the site sends floaters to partner outfitters ('Visit the Affiliates tab ... to book a float'); RV sites are sold to anyone on RoverPass.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, kept): operator claims 'One of the few places in the area Directly on the Jacks Fork River', 'a unique large private Riverfront', 'Premium Riverfront sites available' - LEAD only. The operator's map puts RW1-RW6 at the north edge beside the river; on leaf-off imagery that edge is the back of a ~30-35 m open sand/gravel beach running down to the Jacks Fork (river ~50-60 m wide, riverfront class). The beach is the campground's own day-use swim beach (rule 12 'Do not park on the beach area it is for people'; Google review of a $5 day pass) - it blocks on-water, so riverview is the most it earns, from the RW row's open sightline across the beach. The A/B/C, R, RA, M and P rows are 80-250 m inland under scattered trees.

PIN (optional): stored 37.1519,-91.3556 is on the open field at the east side (the operator map's 'Tent City'), ~135 m SE of the A/B/C RV rows; Google's pin 37.15071,-91.35562 is the entrance/check-in on the road. Suggest ~37.1530,-91.3560 (A/B/C rows) if moved.
